verdict.rationale: Riveter offers a hosted scrape endpoint and lets users configure enrichments from a natural-language prompt or structured spec. Nothing in the evidence shows developers can write, upload, or deploy their own custom scraping scripts or serverless functions on the platform. Prompt-configured managed agents are an adjacent capability, not custom script deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and deploy custom serverless scraping scripts on the platform without managing my own infrastructure
